kitDescription: Soda: Twinkling Bunny is a Burst-III shotgun attacker built around a Golden Chip pool that starts full at 50 and is spent 17 at a time when she bursts (rebuilding +1 for every 3 normal shots she fires inside Full Burst). Her Golden Chips convert live into crit damage (+1.32% each, so ~66% at a full pool, decaying as she spends). While in Full Burst she stacks a short 10.51% Attack-Damage buff onto herself and the single highest-ATK ally, and drops a small per-shot rider onto the nearest enemy. On entering Burst Stage 3 she extends the whole team's Full Burst window (+2s at ≥10 chips, +5s at ≥20), so a well-fed pool yields a 15-second Full Burst. Her burst itself is a 628.7%-ATK nuke, plus self Hit Rate +38.91% (≥20 chips) and self ATK +65.25% (≥30 chips), both gated on the pre-spend pool so the ATK boost lapses on later, drained bursts. The whole kit is a self-fueling loop: chips → crit + longer bursts + self-buffs, drained and rebuilt each rotation.

verdictRationale: GO at faithfulness 1.0 (9/9 kit lines FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED-GAP). The S5 blind spec table converges GREEN with the driver's shipped override on every load-bearing assertion — its load-bearing HYPOTHESIS (Golden Chip is ONE pool with a live perResource crit) is exactly what the driver implemented, and is independently confirmed by FACT 1 plus the t=8 popup arithmetic. The three genuine divergences are all real but all measurement-gated: (1) the skill2 rider's Time-Extension state gating is dropped in favor of a flat-130 approximation — ranked first, documented ⚑ with a recipe, and independently flagged by BOTH cross-family blinds (S2b snapshot, S6 live-proxy) as an engine-primitive gap, not an encoding error; (2) the Hit-Rate downstream core/landing magnitudes are over-credited vs the owner hand-count — a coupled, documented SG measurement residual; (3) the burst nuke omits an explicit noFb flag but is behaviorally FB-exempt via pre-window timing. None is a SILENT_DROP or a prose-contradicting magnitude, so none blocks GO. Discrimination is clean: the S2d matrix shows every counterfactual RED and no test GREEN under both shipped and its nearest-wrong model. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check is the one interpretive fork — that the crit-stack '3 normals in FB' trigger IS the Golden Chip rebuild source (driver + S2b converged, S6 dissented and read the pool as monotonic decay); the driver's unified-currency reading is recording-validated (sim 50/43/38 vs measured 50/44/40/38/31), but since the post-op agents share a model family, the owner should confirm that popup-chip arithmetic and the flat-130 rider magnitude on a dedicated soda-focus recording.
